jobs.title: Strategic GTM Lead - Insurance DACH
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategic GTM Lead for Insurance in DACH: someone who has led client engagements at a top-tier strategy consultancy and now wants to build a market rather than advise on one. You will decide which insurers we go after and why, develop those relationships from first contact to signed partnership, and be the person senior insurance executives trust to think through how AI changes underwriting, claims and operations in their business.

This is not a classic sales role. You will open new strategic insurance accounts and grow them into long-term partnerships, from the first executive conversation to large, account-level commitments. Our Account Executives close individual deals and use cases; you set the direction for the account as a whole. Most of your impact comes from account strategy, executive dialogue, ecosystem work with consultancies and partners, and shaping how Taktile shows up in the German-speaking insurance market. You will work closely with our Head of Insurance, Account Executives, Solution Engineering, Product and Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and prioritize target accounts across DACH insurers (primary insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, insurance groups) based on a clear thesis: where the business case for AI-driven decisioning is strongest and where we can win

  • Build account strategies for your portfolio: map the organization, its strategic agenda and transformation programs, the buying committee and the path to an executive sponsor, and spot expansion opportunities from day one

  • Grow and retain accounts once they are live: steer the overall relationship, open new business lines and country organizations, and make sure clients see lasting value

  • Lead relationships at every level, from claims and underwriting heads to CIOs, COOs and board members, and move them from first conversation to a defined business case and a strategic commitment to Taktile

  • Design and moderate executive workshops and steering meetings with insurance leadership teams, turning open-ended ambitions ("we need to become AI-native") into concrete, prioritized use cases

  • Shape and land account-level commitments (business case, commercial framework, executive sign-off), working hand in hand with the Account Executives who close individual deals, Solution Engineering and our Head of Insurance

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor our platform to each client's needs and turn client requirements into concrete solutions

  • Build and work our ecosystem in DACH: strategy and technology consultancies, system integrators and core system vendors who shape insurers' technology decisions

  • Represent Taktile at industry conferences, roundtables and client events, and help design formats of our own that bring insurance executives together

  • Bring market insight back into Taktile: what insurers need, how competitors and incumbents position, and what that means for our product, messaging and pricing

  • Help build the playbook for Taktile's insurance business in DACH as we scale the team

About You

  • 6+ years of total work experience, including 4–6 years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or a comparable strategy or operations consultancy, ideally leading client teams as Engagement Manager, Project Leader or equivalent

  • Project experience with insurance clients; you don't need to be an insurance specialist, and adjacent work in operations, technical advisory or digital/AI transformation counts

  • A commercial track record: ideally you have sold or expanded projects as an Engagement Manager. Software sales experience is not required

  • Outgoing and client-facing: you enjoy being in front of clients and leading the conversation, rather than working in the background

  • You are comfortable in front of C-level executives: you can structure a difficult discussion, moderate a room of senior stakeholders and hold your own when challenged

  • Strong problem-structuring and business case skills; you can quantify the value of a use case and explain it to a CFO

  • Technical understanding: you can discuss how our platform works with engineers and translate it for business leaders

  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just recommendations, and you are motivated by building revenue and long-term client relationships. High ownership, but a team player, not a lone wolf

  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken

  • Based in Munich or Berlin (Frankfurt or London possible) and happy to travel frequently across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. This is not a remote role: you will regularly work on-site with clients, for example in workshops

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

  • Experience beyond consulting, for example in an industry or in-house role

  • Existing network among senior decision-makers at DACH insurers, insurance consultancies or core system vendors

  • Experience in an enterprise software, insurtech or AI company, for example in a commercial, strategy or business development role

  • Hands-on familiarity with how insurers run claims, underwriting or pricing, and with the regulatory context (BaFin, Solvency II, EU AI Act)

  • Experience speaking at industry events or publishing on insurance and AI topics

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package, with a predominantly fixed salary and a performance-based bonus.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities.

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Retention: If your application is unsuccessful, we retain your data for 12 months after the recruitment process concludes, unless you consent to longer retention. Successful candidates’ data becomes part of their employment records.

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood Taktile’s Applicant Privacy Policy. To exercise your rights or ask questions, contact Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Integrated Producer (German Speaker)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand

Job Description

As a Senior Integrated Producer, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end production process, ensuring seamless execution, financial oversight, and stakeholder coordination. You are expected to balance project management and production expertise, delivering high-budget, complex, and multi-market projects while driving efficiencies, mentorship, and strategic problem-solving. You will collaborate closely with Client Management, Resource Management, and Creative teams, acting as a trusted production lead while maintaining financial and operational control over projects.

Working on a high-profile social media retainer for a titan in the global streaming and entertainment sector, you will sit at the absolute heart of our German market operations. This role is ideal for a producer who thrives in client-facing environments, enjoys hands-on workflow coordination, and brings a strong project management background to fast-paced agency retainers.

 

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary, trusted client-facing lead for German market operations - building strong direct relationships, leading status syncs, navigating client feedback, and providing strategic production solutions.

  • Agile Workflow & Daily Operations: Run daily scrums, triage incoming brief requests, and assign workloads to content managers, copywriters, and motion designers to keep daily social streams moving seamlessly.

  • Financial Oversight & Costing: Lead end-to-end project costing, budgeting, financial forecasting, PO management, and cost reconciliation across high-volume retainer scopes and bespoke campaign spikes.

  • Native Quality Control (QC): Perform meticulous quality control on all German-language social assets (static, video, motion graphics) to guarantee absolute linguistic accuracy, brand alignment, and cultural tone before client delivery.

  • Retainer & Content Production: Oversee end-to-end execution of fast-turnaround social assets, localised multi-market campaigns, and platform-native video deliverables.

  • Resourcing & Mentorship: Partner with Resource Management to cast internal teams and external freelancers effectively, while providing mentorship and workflow guidance to mid-level and junior team members.

     

Qualifications

  • Language Expertise: Native-level fluency in German (written and spoken) is required, along with full professional fluency in English.

  • Social Retainer Background: Extensive experience in an agency environment managing high-volume, fast-turnaround social media retainers is a must.

  • Project Management Synergy: While this is a Senior Integrated Producer role, candidates bringing a strong foundation or background in Project Management - experienced in running scrums, structuring workflows, and tracking deliverables - will be a natural fit.

  • Financial Mastery: Proven proficiency in project costing, budget management, scope estimation, and financial risk mitigation.

  • Client-Facing Mindset: Genuinely enjoys being client-facing and comfortable serving as the day-to-day operational contact for high-level brand partners.

  • Rigorous QC Standards: An exceptional eye for detail, proofreading, and linguistic/visual quality assurance for social content.

  • Experience delivering marketing or social campaigns within film, streaming, TV, or broader entertainment media.

  • Exposure to live-action shoot production logistics and modern AI-driven production workflows.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to

  • • €55K – €60K

jobs.title: Partner Sales Director
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

A strong partner ecosystem is crucial to the success and growth of Kong's business. Partners are a strategic imperative for Kong's continued growth and market expansion. As customer requirements become more complex, we need partners with the capability and capacity to help customers implement, support and grow their usage of Kong. We work closely with cross-functional leadership to ensure partners are integrated throughout the sales cycle, both pre- and post-sale.

The Partner Sales Director owns Kong's partner business within the DACH territory. That means recruiting the right partners, building a real go-to-market motion with them, and driving sourced incremental revenue, not slideware pipeline. The PSD is the single point of contact for anything partner-related: for field sellers who need partner help on a deal, for partners who need a path into Kong, and for leadership setting regional strategy. The ecosystem spans channel resellers, technology partners, GSIs, and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and the PSM works across all four. At the Intermediate level and above, this is a senior individual contributor role: the PSD runs their territory as their own business, in close partnership with the territory's sales leader.

Responsibilities

  • Own the partner revenue number for your assigned territory. Sell Kong's full portfolio (products, renewals, professional services, and support) through and with focus partners.

  • Build the joint go-to-market plan with your territory's sales team. Identify and sign new partners where there are gaps.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline: set targets, run the cadence, and hold partners (and yourself) accountable to them, favoring net-new sourced business over tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway.

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by coordinating deal registration, lead sharing, and co-selling motions for Kong Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Mesh, and Konnect.

  • Build joint assets with focus partners, such as reference architectures, blueprints, and solution briefs that field teams on both sides actually use.

  • Run joint marketing events that generate pipeline, not just logos on a banner.

  • Get inside your partners' business: understand how they make money, where Kong fits, and what it takes to win together. Pull in the right cross-functional support (enablement, CX, marketing, ops) to make the projects land.

  • Build a focus partner plan for your territory and execute it alongside sales engineering, SDRs, customer success, and marketing.

  • Partner with and Partner Sales Engineers to ensure partners have the technical readiness needed to sell and deliver Kong solutions.

  • Build, maintain, and manage relationships with the Kong field sales organization. Proactively engage with Kong AEs, ASMs and geo leadership.

  • Coordinate and facilitate the involvement of Kong team members, including sales leadership and support, as needed to meet sales targets and partner sales objectives.

  • Facilitate territory mapping and identification of new joint opportunities. Resolve route conflicts appropriately.

  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews (QBRs) within your assigned territory, and participate in annual planning within the Partner organization.

  • Provide weekly forecasts and/or progress reports, and keep partner and opportunity data current in Salesforce and other partner management systems.

  • Escalate critical business issues to Partner Sales team management.

  • Prepare presentations, territory plans and reports as required.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with Finance, Partner Operations, Sales Operations, and Sales as needed.

Requirements

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the role, please apply. Nobody checks every box. We're looking for candidates who are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

  • 5+ years in partner, channel, or alliances sales, with a track record of driving go-to-market across channel, GSI, and hyperscaler partners

  • A bias toward net-new, sourced business, not just tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway

  • Comfort running many partners and many activities in parallel without losing the thread on any of them

  • Experience selling infrastructure, developer platforms, or API/AI technology to enterprise buyers

  • Experience selling open source solutions

  • Experience with B2B sales, deal registration, partner quoting, and co-selling motions

  • Experience with Salesforce and partner management systems (e.g., Partner Portal)

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to remain calm under pressure

  • Established personal network within the industry

  • Results-oriented perspective

  • Interest in Kong and open source software; ability to use Kong

  • Shares Kong's values and works in accordance with them

  • Ability to travel up to 50% and comply with the company's travel policy

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und kurzfristig verfügbare Arbeitskräfte effizient miteinander verbindet. Unternehmen nutzen unsere Buchungsplattform, um ihren Personalbedarf in Echtzeit zu decken, während Studierende über unsere Zenjob-App Nebenjobs finden, die sich perfekt mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Zenjobber und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen deutschen Großstädten teilen unsere Überzeugung: Gute Arbeit ist kein Zufall. Sie ist das Ergebnis innovativer Technologie und echter Leidenschaft. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier.

Deine Rolle

Als Teil des Commercial Enablement Teams hilfst du unserem Sales und Account Management Team, unsere Kundenprozesse smarter, schneller und skalierbarer zu machen.

Mit AI und pragmatischen Workflow Tools unterstützt du dabei, Automatisierungspotenziale entlang unserer Go-to-Market-Prozesse von Lead bis Bestandskunde zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Sales und Commercial Operations Prozessen sowie der Identifikation von Effizienzpotenzialen

  • Mitarbeit beim Aufbau von Automatisierungen zur Reduktion operativer Ineffizienzen im Sales und Account Management Umfeld (z. B. mit n8n)

  • Unterstützung bei der Integration von AI in kommerzielle Prozesse, z. B. Lead Generation oder CRM Workflows (Salesforce)

  • Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung pragmatischer Workflows und schneller Tests neuer Use Cases mit Hilfe von AI Tools wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Claude

  • Unterstützung bei der Verbindung unserer Tools und Systeme über APIs, Webhooks oder No Code Plattformen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Account Management, Revenue Operations sowie Product & Engineering

  • Mitarbeit beim Testen, Optimieren und Weiterentwickeln funktionierender Lösungen

Dein Profil

  • Starkes Interesse daran, wie Sales und Go to Market Teams arbeiten

  • Strukturierte Denkweise und pragmatischer Lösungsansatz

  • Interesse an AI, Automatisierung und digitalen Geschäftsprozessen

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Tools, Automatisierungen oder digitalen Workflows von Vorteil

  • Grundverständnisse von Programmierung sowie grundlegenden Web und API Konzepten wünschenswert

  • Laufendes Studium mit technischem, digitalem oder wirtschaftsnahem Schwerpunkt

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Rahmendaten

  • Arbeitszeit: 20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters

  • Standort: Berliner Büro, mit 2 Tagen pro Woche vor Ort

  • Dauer: Mindestlaufzeit von 12 Monaten

Das bieten wir

🌱 Umfassendes Onboarding: Unternehmens-Onboarding, regelmäßige Trainings und eine offene Feedbackkultur

⭐ Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Arbeiten im Büro und remote ermöglicht, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, deinen Hund mit ins Büro zu bringen

🏋️‍♂️ 30 € Zuschuss für den Urban Sports Club, 25 % Rabatt auf eine FitX-Mitgliedschaft

🪩Vierteljährliche Team-Events, Winter- und Sommerfeste, Budget für Geburtstage und Jubiläen unserer Mitarbeitenden

🎥 Schau dir unser Office Tour Video an.

Wir laden dich ein, unsere Karriereseite zu besuchen, unserer LinkedIn Seite zu folgen und dich mit uns auf Instagram in Verbindung zu setzen.

Wir sind stolz ein Arbeitgeber zu sein, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Wir verpflichten uns, jede qualifizierte Person nach ihren Fähigkeiten zu beurteilen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderungsstatus oder Religion. Es ist nicht erforderlich, dein Foto und dein Alter der Bewerbung hinzuzufügen.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect - Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why you'll love this job

Redis has spent over a decade as the fastest in-memory data platform in the world. That foundation is now becoming something bigger: the memory layer for AI. Vector search, semantic caching, agent memory, session state for real-time applications. Every AI system that needs to be fast and reliable eventually needs Redis.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll educate and collaborate with customers to design Redis-powered solutions for their specific business and technical needs, including the new generation of AI-driven applications. You'll drive POCs, pilots, and evaluations, working hands-on with customers using one of the most widely adopted technologies in the market.

This is an early moment in that shift. Joining now means helping shape how Redis shows up in AI architectures across the region, not inheriting a playbook someone else already wrote.

The ideal candidate is a good listener with a talent for creative, technical solutions. You enjoy tackling a wide variety of technical challenges patiently and pragmatically, never losing sight of the customer's business objectives.

If you're a technology expert who wants to give customers the best possible experience, and you're excited about being close to how AI infrastructure actually gets built, this is the right challenge for you.

Redis hires for this and similar roles on an ongoing basis, so your application will be collected and kept on file as needs arise, subject to applicable law. Redis may not contact you immediately after you apply.

What you'll do

  • Help customers meet their technology and business requirements using Redis products, solutions, and services, including AI-focused use cases like vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and semantic caching.

  • Understand, quantify, and verify the business needs of customers and their specific use cases, from traditional database workloads to emerging AI architectures.

  • Work closely with customers' technical teams (architects, developers, PMOs, and C-level stakeholders) to ensure the success of every POC and pilot.

  • Collaborate with the sales team to develop account strategies and identify new opportunities, both in new accounts and existing ones.

  • Present Redis, its capabilities, and its role in modern AI infrastructure in a professional and compelling way that helps customers see the business impact and competitive advantage of the Redis platform.

  • Use customer feedback and insights to improve technical materials and best practices, while feeding learnings back to product management and R&D as the AI use cases evolve.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering (ideally database engineering) for enterprise software.

  • Hands-on experience with server-side software development and Linux.

  • Experience with scalable, highly available distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML application architectures is a plus (vector databases, RAG pipelines, LLM-based applications), though not required.

  • BS in Computer Science, BA, or equivalent work experience.

  • A team player with excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Able to travel regularly to visit customer sites.

  • Excellent written and spoken English and German

Compensation: The salary range for this role is EUR 105 000 to 131 000. Final compensation will be determined based on objective, job-related factors, including relevant experience, skills, role scope, level, and work location. This role may also be eligible for commission and Redis benefits.

As a global company, we value a culture of curiosity, diversity of thought, and innovation from our employees, customers, and partners. Redis is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment where all employees’ differences are celebrated and supported, and everyone feels safe to bring their authentic selves to work. Redis is dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard, and every idea is respected.

Redis is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require accommodations for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to

Any offer of employment at Redis is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable laws.

Redis reserves the right to retain data longer than stated in the privacy policy in order to evaluate candidates.

jobs.title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems.

  • Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments.

  • Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies.

  • Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

  • Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data.

  • Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings.

  • Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent

  • You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments

  • You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity

  • Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus

  • Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.
